objective: Explain and preserve breadth-first traversal invariants.

coaching_cards.title: Protect the visited-set invariant
coaching_cards.misconception: A traversal can enqueue the same node through two parents unless it marks nodes when they enter the frontier.
coaching_cards.corrective_question: What prevents node D from entering the frontier twice when B and C both point to it?
coaching_cards.hint: Ask: when is a node added to `visited`, and can another parent enqueue it before then?

mutation.symptom: D can enter the frontier twice through B and C.
